purpose: Require the noncovariant Refracted Gravity 3-D operator to reproduce primary-paper equations, analytic limits, a manufactured variable-coefficient solution, and the spherical Gauss-law solution before any real-response scoring.

primary_sources.title: Dynamics of galaxies and clusters in refracted gravity
primary_sources.role: original noncovariant density-dependent gravitational-permittivity proposal and galaxy/cluster phenomenology

primary_sources.title: Dynamics of DiskMass Survey galaxies in refracted gravity
primary_sources.role: exact weak-field PDE, smooth permittivity law, numerical method, published parameter priors, approximate universal parameter estimate, and adverse RAR evidence

primary_sources.title: Refracted Gravity Solutions from Small to Large Scales
primary_sources.role: current theory-scope review; not used as a substitute for the two primary derivations

published_operator.expanded_equation: epsilon_rho grad(rho).grad(phi) + epsilon(rho) laplacian(phi) = 4 pi G rho
published_operator.high_density_limit: epsilon -> 1 and Newtonian Poisson is recovered
published_operator.low_density_limit: epsilon -> epsilon_0 and the field is enhanced by 1/epsilon_0 for constant epsilon_0
published_operator.functional_form_boundary: The DiskMass paper explicitly calls the smooth step an arbitrary viability ansatz; benchmark success validates the implementation, not uniqueness or truth of the ansatz.

universal_diskmass_median.use: fixed published forward-control parameters; never refit from PHANGS, THINGS, S4G, SPARC, or X-COP responses

sensitivity_cells.construction: the eight Cartesian corners of the published flat-prior bounds plus the universal median
sensitivity_cells.role: predeclared source/operator sensitivity only; not response-fitted alternatives

published_counterevidence.statement: The DiskMass paper reports that a single approximate universal parameter combination worsens the rotation-curve agreement for a substantial part of its sample.
The DiskMass paper reports RG acceleration underestimates of roughly 0.1 to 0.3 dex at low Newtonian acceleration.
The DiskMass paper reports strong residual correlations and non-null model scatter that may be genuine RG failures or sample-specific limitations.

benchmark_contract.normalized_units: Synthetic operator tests use G=1 and dimensionless coordinates/densities; the published rho_c value and unit conversion are separately frozen and tested.

manufactured_fields.rhs: analytic div[epsilon(rho) grad(phi)], independently differentiated from the published law

spherical_fields.boundary: radial potential integrated from the published spherical flux law on every Cartesian boundary node

admission_rule.benchmark_pass: eligible only for a later real-source, development-response execution using the fixed published control and predeclared sensitivities
admission_rule.benchmark_failure: retain exact failure as numerical or theory counterevidence; do not score
admission_rule.novel_extension: may differ from conventional models, but must preserve a known-limit control and pass an independently checkable operator benchmark before response testing
